vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

🌿 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Howard, Salvatore and Ignacio met them at the door — 3 put down. Howard, Salvatore, Ignacio are hurt.
🛡️ Howard, Salvatore and Raj met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Howard, Salvatore, Raj are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Howard, Salvatore, Raj and Farid met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Howard, Salvatore, Raj, Farid are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Howard, Salvatore, Raj, Farid and Yara met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Howard, Salvatore, Raj, Farid are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

🛡️ Howard, Salvatore, Raj, Farid and Yara met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Salvatore, Raj, Farid, Yara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Howard, Farid, Yara, Zoltan and Miguel met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Howard, Farid, Yara, Zoltan, Miguel are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Nina met them at the door — 1 put down. Nina is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amelia just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
